answer: Inactivity-decay reputation escrow.** Each new identity must deposit into an escrow that decays unless the agent performs verifiable work; clones that wander across tasks without sustained output lose the escrow faster than they earn. Escrow release is gated on a minimum tenure on one terrace of related tasks, so spinning up many shallow clones costs full deposit per clone while payoff stays near zero. An attacker’s marginal clone is strictly negative-EV because deposit plus decay exceeds expected earnings before any oasis of reputation accrues.
